title: import-payload emits single next_command
summary: import-payload: next_command routing; seed .agentic/releases/unreleased and DEFAULT_CONFIG .plate JSON when missing (never overwrite) so offline adoption core_ready is reachable after apply.
migration_impact: Additive only. Clients reading next_steps continue to work; prefer next_command for agent routing (parity with adopt/self-migrate).
agent_notes: After import-payload --apply, expect .plate + releases/unreleased + next_command. Never overwrite existing .plate. .plate is JSON (v1.2), not YAML.
